scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const src = path.resolve('src/db/d1-migrations'), dst = path.resolve('dist/db/d1-migrations'); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.mkdirSync(dst, { recursive: true }); fs.readdirSync(src).filter(f => f.endsWith('.sql')).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, f), path.join(dst, f))); }"
